summary: Iteration 2 — Two-user E2E for chat+marketplace and reel comments/share. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_reel_social_and_chat.py (28 tests, 28 pass) covering reel comments CRUD (empty 400, cross-RT 403, delete by reel-owner & by non-author 403, notification REEL_COMMENT, comment_count +/-), reel share (cross-RT 403, cross-RT viewer sees reel.unavailable:true, same-RT embeds reel object, notification REEL_SHARE, no-RT-membership 400/403), and full two-user marketplace→chat flow (merchant create, product create, buyer discovers product, saves, opens merchant, phone hidden for non-owner, starts chat, sends, seller unread count, seller reads+replies, buyer receives, umkm/nearby shows seller store). UI phase in Playwright on mobile 390px with two browser contexts: Seller A + Buyer B both verified-residents in same ACTIVE RT (RT005 Gandaria Utara). ALL critical flows passed in UI: buyer product discovery, save, toko tab search, merchant detail, 'Chat Penjual' button, chat conversation open+send, seller chat-badge appears within 2.5s (polling), seller opens conv and sees buyer message, seller replies, buyer sees reply within 2.5s (polling). umkm-card-<mid> on home opens /app/marketplace?toko=<mid> correctly. Reel comments: open sheet, empty state visible, send comment, delete own comment — all via UI. Reel share: dialog opens, submit creates feed post, /app/feed shows feed-reel-<reelId> embed. Backend 28/28 + previous iteration 31/31 = 59/59 new-feature tests passing.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Chat Penjual' creates the conversation via POST /api/chat/conversations then navigates to /app/chat (list view). It does NOT auto-open the newly-created conversation; the buyer must manually tap the conv row to start typing. For a 'click → type' purchase intent this is a visible friction point. Fix: either (a) pass ?with=<peer_user_id> or ?cid=<convId> query param and auto-setActive on mount, or (b) have chatSeller setActive via a shared store, or (c) navigate to /app/chat/<cid>.

action_items: (MEDIUM UX) Marketplace.chatSeller() should auto-open the created conversation on /app/chat (e.g. navigate(`/app/chat?cid=${conv.id}`) and have Chat.jsx read searchParams on mount to setActive). Current behavior forces an extra manual click.
(Carried from iter-1, optional) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to StoryComposer and other shadcn Dialogs to silence a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/reels.py comments & share: permissions correct — comment author OR reel owner can delete (line 117), reel.visibility enforced via _visible() → can_view() (lines 54-60), share requires rt_id (line 132), notify fires only when actor != owner. Good.

routers/social.py list_feed embeds reel with can_view(reel, v) → {unavailable:true} fallback — correct. Note: feed itself is NOT RT-filtered (q only filters by category/rt_id when explicit) → non-member of RT can see post rows; mitigated by reel.unavailable but non-reel feed posts remain cross-RT visible. Already flagged as known behaviour in review request.
chat.py send_message / start_conversation / unread-count all correct and consistent; idempotency via client_message_id works.

marketplace.py: product save toggle idempotent; phone hidden for non-owner when phone_public=false; merchant-chat creates/finds conversation (idempotent via sorted-pair). No ObjectId leakage (all projections exclude _id).
chat.py presence/typing use process-local dicts — won't work with multiple workers but acceptable for single-uvicorn MVP.

success_rate.backend: 28/28 (100%) new-feature tests this iteration; 59/59 cumulative with iter-1
success_rate.frontend: 100% of specified UI flows verified end-to-end on mobile 390px (login, marketplace discovery/save/scope/tabs, merchant detail, chat send, chat-badge polling, bidirectional messaging polling, umkm-nearby + deep-link, reel comments add/delete, reel share dialog, feed-reel embed)
